column1: # Per-file hashes of weight trees, recorded in this repo at fetch time (not guessed).
# dest<TAB>path in the tree<TAB>bytes ("-" = not recorded)<TAB>algo:hex
# Checked by `verify-weights.sh sha:<dest>` (reads every listed file). Sources:
#   h3-ref2va          artifacts/runpod/fetch-h3-ref2va/{s2k01690bi,jg48s6o1w0}/sha256.txt (US = EU; Hub LFS SHA-256 at the pinned revisions)
#   ltx25-ic-lora-ingredients  docs/ports/ltx-ref2v.md (Hub LFS oid; both volumes)
#   mmaudio-44k-v2     the md5s scripts/gpu/fetch-mmaudio.py pins (MMAudio download_utils.py); the
#                      converted safetensors/ files have no recorded hash
#   longlive-1.3b, longlive2-5b*, longlive-plug/*  artifacts/runpod/fetch-<dest with / as ->-fv-weights-*/sha256.txt
#                      (fetch-hub-tree.py: every file = Hub LFS SHA-256 / git blob at the pinned revision; US = EU,
#                      the US copy checked against the EU list). Bytes from the Hub listing.
#                      longlive_base.safetensors is listed as US|EU: the two files differ only in the order of the
#                      two __metadata__ entries in the header; tensor table and data are identical (2026-10-02).
# Trees with hashes elsewhere: auxiliary/ (weights-manifest.tsv, cell aux), auxiliary/upscalers/
# (cell upscalers), */text_encoder_fp8 (cell text-fp8), the upscaler file (cell sol-h3-spark).
